### WhatsApp Web's Status and Channels are blocked in Chrome again
With the WhatsApp guard on, opening Status or Channels in WhatsApp Web let you straight through in Chrome, Brave, Edge and the other Chrome-based browsers. The Mac could not see which tab WhatsApp was showing, so it allowed all of them. Safari and Firefox were never affected, and the same block inside the WhatsApp app kept working throughout.
